name: Linda L. Small
office: Whittier City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Linda Small was elected to the Whittier City School District Governing Board for Trustee Area 5 in 2022. She works as a senior safety consultant. She says she has served the district's community for 35 years through the school board, the YMCA board, and the WCSD Educational Foundation.
